{{Infobox Football league season | competition = [[Chinese Jia-A League]] | season = 1998 | winners = [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] (4th title) | relegated = {{ubl|[[Bayi Football Team|August 1st]] | [[Guangzhou F.C.|Guangzhou Apollo]]}} | continentalcup1 = [[1999–2000 Asian Club Championship|Asian Club Championship]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Wanda]] | league topscorer = [[Hao Haidong]] (18 goals) | matches = 182 | total goals = 437 | average attendance = 21,335 | prevseason = [[1997 Chinese Jia-A League|1997]] | nextseason = [[1999 Chinese Jia-A League|1999]] }} The '''1998 [[Chinese Jia-A League]] season''' (known as '''[[Marlboro]] Jia-A League''' for sponsorship reasons) was the fifth season of professional association football and the 37th top-tier overall league season held in China.
